lines.1: We met up with Subaru after track practice.
lines.2: 「I'm starving. Crab's working today, right? Let's grab something at Oasis.」
lines.3: 「Sure, why not? We can do our part for the local economy.」
lines.7: Its slogan is, 'Matsukasa: the City of Curry.'
lines.8: Curry shops dot the whole city, and Oasis here is no exception.
lines.9: Incidentally, the face on Crab's apron belongs to the manager.
lines.10: 「Have you decided on your orders? Perhaps I could interest you in the 'Cute Waitress's Whimsical Recommendation'?」
lines.11: 「No thanks. That'll just be a mountain of fukujinzuke or something. Mild beef curry.」
lines.14: 「Tch... No sense of adventure... This is what's wrong with Japanese people. You could all learn something from our Indian manager.」
lines.18: An Indian guy named Alex... No, judging people by their names is wrong.
lines.19: 「By the way, are you stuck in that pose?」
lines.20: 「Can't you feel the timeless spirit of India in these hands? I get docked pay if I break the pose.」
lines.21: Crab loves curry and took this job for the staff meals, so naturally, the curry here is delicious.
lines.22: Its old-fashioned flavor really hits the spot.
lines.25: 「Whoa, she's gorgeous.」 (He never misses that sort of thing.)
lines.26: 「Nwooooooh! She's here! Manager! It's the Spicy Curry King!」
lines.27: 「OH! Calm down, Miss Kinu. First we take her ORDER!」
lines.31: 「The ultra-hot special... Oh, it's that thing where finishing it makes it free, and you can try as many times as you want.」
lines.32: 「I tried it before and went down after one bite... Started sweating in places I didn't know I had.」
lines.33: 「SHIIIT! She will probably eat it all again. We should wave the white flag!」
lines.34: 「...Damn it... Is that our only option? I told you unlimited attempts would trap us in an infinite combo!」
lines.36: 「She laughed at me, that bitch! Thinks she's so great just because it looks like she's got big boobs!」
lines.37: 「Forget it, Manager. If she finishes it, take the loss out of my paycheck. I accept her challenge!」
lines.38: 「If you insist, fine, but she already finished it once. Do you have anything like a PLAN?」
lines.39: 「Easy. Just add spices all the way up to the limit. She'll breathe fire.」
lines.40: 「That would normally be a lethal dose.」
lines.42: 「Making it any hotter without ruining the flavor is DIFFICULT... but very well.」
lines.47: 「Hey, she's eating it like it's nothing. Who the hell is she?」
lines.48: 「All right, now's my chance to try something I've always wanted to do. Hey, stupid-looking waitress!」
lines.50: 「Send that beautiful woman a Ceylon tea on me.」
lines.51: 「Even with that defective brain of yours, don't forget to say, 'From the gentleman over there.'」
lines.54: 「She's still an employee. The customer comes first.」
lines.55: 「One complimentary hot Ceylon tea! It's from the gentleman with glasses over there.」
lines.56: 「You idio-- She's eating spicy food, so obviously it should be iced! Why is that thing steaming?!」
lines.57: 「Mm... I like it boiling hot. Goes well with curry.」
lines.60: 「Impossible... I heated it enough to burn her throat and kill her.」
lines.62: 「That was delicious. I finished it, so it's free.」
lines.63: 「Ugh... That is correct. Thank you very MUUCH!」
lines.65: She delivered the thanks in an incredibly blunt tone.
lines.68: 「Heh heh. I actually talked to her.」
lines.71: 「I'm not crying! I'm not crying at all!!」
lines.72: 「Guh... She finished ultra-hot curry handmade by a manager raised in India... Seriously, who is she...?」
lines.73: 「Sooorry. Actually, I was raised in America.」
lines.76: 「J-J-Just kidding! It was a JOKE. I was born in New Delhi.」
lines.77: Is this place going to be okay?
lines.78: Well, whatever his nationality is, the food tastes good. That's what matters.
